checkpoints.description: [1/4] Cycle 1: fix the post-victory dead end where Escape dismisses the win dialog, freezes the board and hides every next step; reopen the result from the won loom by pointer and keyboard, tell the player, and prove it with a before/after pair plus a played solve-dismiss-reopen-next run

impact_assessment.why: After a win, pressing Escape closes the victory dialog and leaves Undo/Reset/Hint disabled with no visible Next or Replay path; a real played run reproduced dialogOpen=false, frozen move count and no recovery affordance except Chambers.
impact_assessment.benefits: Keeps the finished tapestry inspectable while restoring a clear Next/Replay path, works for pointer and keyboard, adds no new control, no save change and no new dependency.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: win-dialog close handler and beginDraft won branch; dependency: none; concurrency: single writer on a clean weft tree; state: no save schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first browser dogfood assertion records the pre-fix dead end, before/after screenshots at 1440x900 from the same fresh-profile first chamber, full npm test plus aikit check and dogfood after the fix, explicit staging, no push

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Implemented the won-loom recovery: beginDraft reopens the victory dialog, the close handler adds the recovery hint, dogfood pins Escape-reopen-Next to Chamber 02 and fails on page errors; captured a same-state 1440x900 before/after pair and wrote ADR-023 plus the cycle record
[3/4] Phase 4 green: 89/89 tests, 5/5 aikit gates, dogfood 0 page errors with the Escape-reopen-Next flow, before/after pair at 1440x900 on the same first-chamber solve; checklists: passed
Task 'weft-cycle-01' completed successfully.

[1/4] Cycle 2: stop the reset/undo time rollback where Reset zeroes the timer but Undo restores the worked board, producing a fake 1.7s best from an 8.8s played run; make Reset a clean attempt (no undo, no stale hint ghost, fresh timer) while hints still count, and prove it with a before/after reset-state pair plus a dogfood reset run

impact_assessment.why: A played First Thread run drew two threads for 3.7s, reset the timer to 00:00, undid the reset to restore both threads, and won at 00:01 with saved bestMs 1662ms instead of the 8.8s real attempt; the Undo button after Reset is the exploit affordance.
impact_assessment.benefits: Best times and wins reflect the real attempt, Reset has one unambiguous meaning, a stale hint ghost cannot survive onto a cleared loom, and no save format or engine rule changes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: resetLevel outcome (undo stack, timer, hint ghost); dependency: none; concurrency: single writer on a clean weft tree; state: timer and UI state only, no save schema change
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first dogfood assertion for undoDisabled/hintThread/empty board after Reset, before/after screenshots at 1440x900 with the same two-thread reset state, full npm test plus aikit check and dogfood, explicit staging, no push

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Implemented the clean Reset: resetLevel clears the undo stack and active hint ghost while keeping hints counted, dogfood pins the reset state on Chamber 02, and the before/after pair shows the pre-fix 00:00 board restore vs the cleared post-fix board

[3/4] Phase 4 green: 89/89 tests, 5/5 aikit gates, dogfood 0 page errors with the Reset-hygiene flow, played exploit run before 00:01/1662ms vs after 00:02/2887ms honest post-reset attempt, before/after pair at 1440x900; checklists: passed
Task 'weft-cycle-02' completed successfully.

[1/4] Cycle 3: fix the mobile How-to-play dialog opening scrolled 158px past its title because showModal focuses the bottom Ready button; focus the heading and reset the dialog scroll, prove with a 390x844 before/after pair and a dogfood open-focus-close played run

impact_assessment.why: At 390x844 the help dialog is 876px of content in a 718px frame; native showModal autofocuses the footer Ready button, setting scrollTop=158 and leaving the heading at -45.7px, so the title and first rules are hidden on open.
impact_assessment.benefits: The how-to-play dialog always opens at its title, keyboard and screen-reader users hear the heading first, and no layout, save or engine rule changes.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: help-dialog initial focus and scroll; dependency: none; concurrency: single writer on a clean weft tree; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first dogfood assertion for scrollTop=0 and focused help-title, 390x844 before/after capture from ?preview=help, full npm test plus aikit check and dogfood, explicit staging, no push

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Implemented the help-heading focus and scroll reset, captured the 390x844 before/after pair, pinned real-click open/escape in dogfood, and repaired the flaky wall-clock daily test with deterministic search-work bounds plus a fixed dogfood viewport

[3/4] Phase 4 green: 89/89 tests under 100% host load, 5/5 aikit gates, dogfood 3 consecutive runs with 0 page errors, help opens scrollTop=0 with active help-title at 390x844 and 1440x900, before/after pair committed; checklists: passed
Task 'weft-cycle-03' completed successfully.

[1/4] Cycle 4: stop unknown chamber ids in a poisoned or legacy save from inflating the campaign totals; filter solvedCount/totalStars by the live level list, prove with a same-save 1440x900 title pair and a dogfood poisoned-save reload run

impact_assessment.why: A save with 24 unknown solved ids made the title read '24 of 24 woven · 72/72 stars · next: First Thread' while the chamber index showed only one unlocked chamber and zero real stars; isUnlocked already rejects unknown ids but the totals still count them.
impact_assessment.benefits: Campaign counts, the completion message and the next-chamber line agree with the actual levels; a corrupt or legacy save cannot fake completion; no save migration, engine rule or layout change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: solvedCount/totalStars optional levels argument and app call sites; dependency: none; concurrency: single writer on a clean weft tree; state: read-only filtering of the existing save
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first dogfood injection and unit tests for unknown ids, same poisoned-save title screenshots at 1440x900, full npm test plus aikit check and dogfood, explicit staging, no push

checkpoints.description: [3/4] Phase 4 green: 90/90 tests, 5/5 aikit gates, dogfood 0 page errors with the ghost-save reload, before/after title pair from the same 24-ghost save at 1440x900; checklists: passed
[2/4] Implemented the level-aware campaign totals with unit coverage, dogfood poisoned-save reload checks, the same-save 1440x900 title pair and the 90-test README count
Task 'weft-cycle-04' completed successfully.

[1/4] Cycle 5: replace the generic circle on each chamber card with a generated mini-loom preview of its spool layout, so players can read chamber size and spool positions before opening it; prove with a 1440x900 levels before/after pair and a dogfood preview count plus card-click run

impact_assessment.why: Every chamber card shows the same decorative circle; the only per-chamber visual is text (size and thread count), so the index cannot convey the shape or spool distribution of 24 different looms at a glance.
impact_assessment.benefits: The index becomes a visual campaign map, locked and solved cards stay comparable, and the preview is generated from the existing level data with no asset, save or engine change.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: generated .level-mini SVG inside each card plus card decoration CSS; dependency: none; concurrency: single writer on a clean weft tree; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first dogfood assertions for one preview per card and the right spool counts on the 5x5 and 12x12 ends, 1440x900 before/after pair from a fresh index, full npm test plus aikit check and dogfood, explicit staging, no push

checkpoints.description: [2/4] Implemented generated mini-loom previews on all 24 chamber cards, pinned preview counts and card-click entry in dogfood, captured the 1440x900 pair and checked the 390x844 render
[3/4] Phase 4 green: 90/90 tests, 5/5 aikit gates, dogfood 0 page errors with 24 previews and a card click, before/after index pair at 1440x900; checklists: passed
